title: Brazil commits $444M to sovereign AI supercomputers split between Huawei and Nvidia
summary: Brazil is funding a Huawei-iFlytek supercomputer project in Rio and a separate tender likely favouring Nvidia, to avoid dependence on one vendor or country.
reason: Sovereign compute spreads capacity; modest size.

title: OpenAI urges California to add training-time monitoring to SB 53

reason: Lab lobbying for stronger oversight; proposal only.

title: Nvidia harness scores 100 on public ARC-AGI-3 levels
